doc: stages/readers.obj.rst: 'This reader constructs a mesh from the faces specified in the OBJ file, ignoring vertices that are not associated with any face.' and stages/filters.faceraster.rst: 'Each raster cell is given a value that is an interpolation of the known values of containing triangle.  If the raster cell center is outside of the triangulation, it is assigned the nodata_ value.  Use `writers.raster` to write the output.'
